subject: Post-call: Data residency & export controls (SOC 2 / GDPR / OFAC)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Laura Simmons <laura.simmons@acmehealth.com>, Tom Berger <tberger@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-18T13:05:00Z
Subject: Post-call: Data residency & export controls (SOC 2 / GDPR / OFAC)

Hi Laura / Tom 

Thanks for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery call and agreed next steps below.

Summary of asks you raised:
- Confirm SOC 2 status and latest report access
- GDPR/HIPAA support and whether we sign a BAA
- EU-only data residency options and cross-border transfer controls
- Any OFAC / ITAR restrictions relevant to processing Acme Health data
- Start the vendor security questionnaire (you mentioned a spreadsheet)

What we covered on the call:
- Redwood is SOC 2 Type II (most recent audit concluded 2025) I can share the auditor summary and controls mapping.
- We support HIPAA-covered workloads and are willing to sign a BAA; our Security & Legal teams have a standard BAA template.
- EU region availability: we run production clusters in eu-west-1 (Ireland) and eu-central-1 (Frankfurt) and can scope your org to EU-only data residency.
- Cross-border transfers: we offer a DPA with Standard Contractual Clauses and additional contractual measures; can provide a DPA draft.
- OFAC/ITAR: we screen customers/activities for OFAC sanctions; ITAR-controlled data has export restrictions and typically cannot be processed in cross-border clouds without specific controls we flagged this as a follow-up item.

Attachments: I attached the vendor security questionnaire template and a SOC 2 summary for your review. For full SOC 2 reports we typically exchange via a secure link under an NDA happy to push that to you once the NDA is in place.

Agreed next steps:
1) Laura/Tom: confirm whether Acme will share the questionnaire now or want us to pre-populate the vendor spreadsheet (you mentioned preferred).
2) Marissa (me): send SOC2 summary + DPA draft + link to sign NDA (DocuSign).
3) Neha: loop in Solutions Engineering for EU PoC and latency/cost estimate.
4) If there are any ITAR-specific datasets, please flag; we'll coordinate legal/engineering.

If this looks right I can follow up with the attachments and links now.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachment stubs:
- vendor_security_questionnaire.xlsx (Excel, 42KB)
- SOC2-report-2025-summary.pdf (PDF, 120KB)

Hi Marissa 

Thanks for the clear recap, that matches our notes. A couple of clarifications from our security and privacy teams:

1) We can share the vendor questionnaire (we'll attach it below) would you be able to pre-fill the sections related to infrastructure and controls? That will speed our review.
2) For SOC 2: our compliance lead needs the audit period dates and whether the report includes system-level controls for data encryption and key management.
3) HIPAA / BAA: we require an execution timeline can you confirm how long it typically takes?
4) EU-only residency: important for us to ensure no backups or logs are routed outside EU; please confirm the approach you take for backups and DR.
5) OFAC/ITAR: we do have some datasets that may be subject to export controls can you confirm whether Redwood will accept ITAR-designated data into EU regions or if that is restricted?

We're attaching our questionnaire. If you can pre-populate and return by end of week, that would be ideal. Also, please include any links/docs for SOC2 and the DPA.

Thanks Laura
Laura Simmons
Head of Security & Compliance, Acme Health

Subject: Re: Post-call: Data residency & export controls (SOC 2 / GDPR / OFAC)

Hi Laura / Tom 

Appreciate the detail  answers inline below and next steps.

1) Questionnaire: we're happy to pre-fill the vendor questionnaire. I've populated the infrastructure and controls tabs and attached the filled file (vendor_security_questionnaire_filled.xlsx).

2) SOC 2: we completed a SOC 2 Type II audit covering Jan 1, 2025 - Dec 31, 2025. The auditor report includes system-level controls around encryption at rest/in transit, key management, access controls, and change management. The summary is attached; we can provide the full report under NDA.

3) HIPAA / BAA: Redwood supports HIPAA workloads and we have a standard BAA. Typical execution timeline is 3-5 business days once legal review is complete on both sides. We'll route to Legal immediately after you confirm.

4) EU-only residency & backups/DR: we can provision tenant data to eu-west-1 (Ireland) or eu-central-1 (Frankfurt) and restrict processing to those regions. Backups are stored in the same region by default; cross-region backups are an opt-in config and will only be enabled with explicit customer approval. We include these controls in the DPA.

5) OFAC / ITAR: regarding ITAR due to export-control constraints, we do not recommend processing ITAR-restricted data in public clouds without a specific legal routing and facilities review. If you have ITAR datasets, flag them and our legal/infra teams will engage. OFAC: we screen entities and will comply with sanctions lists; if Acme expects transactions involving sanctioned parties, we will need to review scope.

Attachments included here: SOC2-report-2025-summary.pdf, DPA-Redwood-2026.pdf, vendor_security_questionnaire_filled.xlsx.

Links:
- HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/ACME-2026-031
- DocuSign (NDA/BBA routing to follow): https://www.docusign.com/REDWOOD-NDA-ACME
- Shared security responses: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0B3-example-security-responses

Next steps (proposed):
- I will return the filled questionnaire and attach the DPA draft (attached).
- Marissa -> Legal to send BAA for signature upon Acme confirmation.
- Neha -> SE to scope EU PoC and provide latency/cost estimate (cc'd).

If you'd like I can also schedule a short 30-min follow-up with Solutions Engineering to go over PoC requirements next week.

Thanks,
Marissa
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
